units.en: The ⟦0⟧, also known as ⟦1⟧, is a minor nation in eastern Asia with a population of ⟦2⟧ in the 1936 start date. It borders ⟦3⟧ to the north and east, ⟦4⟧ to the west, and the ⟦5⟧ to the south. Communist China begins the game controlling the small and poor states of Shaanbei and Yulin with few factories and poorly equipped troops. However, its mountainous terrain, reasonable population, and starting forts provide a strong defensive position and a base from which it can expand its influence in China, with the potential to emerge as the underdog victor of the Chinese Civil War.

In 1912 following the Xinhai Revolution, the Qing Dynasty collapsed, and the Republic of China was formed. However, various warlords also arose, carving out territories from the former empire. In 1921, with the Western powers having ignored pleas for aid in confronting the warlords, the ⟦0⟧ answered by supporting both the Communist Party of China and the much larger Chinese nationalist Kuomintang government of the ⟦1⟧. Under Soviet urging, the two sides formed the First United Front in 1923. In 1927, tensions between communists and nationalists flared, with left-wing KMT members either joining Mao Zedong's CPC or being purged by Chiang Kai-shek's right wing KMT. Soon, armed communist revolts erupted between both parties and the Ten Year Civil War began.

Nationalist campaigns into communist territory in southern China were interrupted from 1929 through 1931, when Japanese expansion into Manchuria (the Mukden Incident and subsequent territorial concessions) and Northern China halted nationalist offenses for a time. Mao's forces declared independence as an otherwise unrecognized ⟦0⟧ existing in various pockets throughout China. 1932 to 1933 saw limited success for the KMT, though new failure to halt ⟦1⟧ forced demilitarization of the area around Beijing. But in 1934, careful encircling maneuvers crushed communist pockets, leading Mao's forces to exile on the Long March, nearly obliterating the communists in the process. However, the surviving communists reorganized in Yan'an in far northern China during 1935-1936. There, Mao's conviction in communism's inevitability strengthened. The civil war was temporarily halted in 1937 when ⟦2⟧ invaded ⟦3⟧ and the CPC and KMT formed the Second United Front to battle the Japanese, but almost immediately resumed after the latter's surrender, ending with the Republic of China's retreat to Taiwan and the establishment of the People's Republic of China under Mao on the mainland.
Main article: Communist Chinese national focus tree

⟦0⟧ got a unique national focus tree as part of the Waking the Tiger expansion. Ever since the DLC's integration, it is now available in the base game. It received its own unique expansion of their national focus tree in the ⟦1⟧ Expansion Pack DLC.

The beginning of the focus tree. The focus gives ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧.

This path gives the 28½ Bolsheviks influence in the ⟦0⟧ which focuses more on aligning itself towards the ⟦1⟧. It makes ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ as leader of the nation.

Towards One China/Allow Autonomous Regions/Seek a Peaceful Reunification Sub-branch The expansion section on the bottom of the political branch first either gains war goals against non-allied Chinese nations, request subjugation from allied Chinese nations as well as war goals against non-allied Chinese nations, or request annexation of the Chinese leader, as well as integration of the warlords. Afterwards the country will then form the People's Republic of China. Then, the left side of the section focuses on expansion towards Taiwan with naval invasion bonuses and towards Tibetan and Korean cores. The right side drifts the country towards Democracy and becomes the Chinese Republic, or sets the power towards the Communist party. The bottom of the section either declares war against western nations that own Chinese cores, declares war against surrounding Asian nations, or builds a faction with Democratic Asian nations.

The expansion section on the bottom of the political branch first either gains war goals against non-allied Chinese nations, request subjugation from allied Chinese nations as well as war goals against non-allied Chinese nations, or request annexation of the Chinese leader, as well as integration of the warlords. Afterwards the country will then form the ⟦0⟧. Then, the left side of the section focuses on expansion towards Taiwan with naval invasion bonuses and towards ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ cores. The right side drifts the country towards ⟦3⟧ and becomes the Chinese Republic, or sets the power towards the ⟦4⟧ party. The bottom of the section either declares war against western nations that own Chinese cores, declares war against surrounding Asian nations, or builds a faction with ⟦5⟧ Asian nations.
